outcome: Concentrations of carotenoids (β-carotene, β-cryptoxanthin, lutein, lycopene, zeaxanthin) and tocopherols (α-tocopherol, γ-tocopherol) in human milk
finding: Human milk concentrations of carotenoids and tocopherols varied significantly across lactation stages and regions, with maternal education, delivery mode, and present body mass index also being associated with these levels.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was found to be associated with human milk concentrations of carotenoids.
